does: Cuts a cured, spiced sausage into thin rounds and fries them briefly over medium heat, until the fat runs red and the edges curl and crisp, without letting them harden.

intro.what: Frying a cured sausage cooks thin rounds briefly until their spiced fat runs.
intro.why: It teaches that cured meat needs only a short heat to release its fat and flavour.

how: Peel off the casing if it is tough.
Cut the sausage into thin rounds of one thickness.
Warm a pan over medium heat with very little fat, or none.
Lay in the rounds and fry, turning once, until the fat runs and the edges curl.
Take the pan off the heat as soon as they are done, or cook the next thing in the red fat.

cues.text: The fat runs red into the pan and the edges of the rounds curl up.
A warm smell of garlic and spice, with no sharp, burnt note.

mistakes.mistake: Frying the rounds over high heat or for too long, so that they turn hard and bitter.
mistakes.fix: Keep the heat medium and take them off as soon as the edges curl.

mistakes.mistake: Cutting thick, uneven rounds, so that some burn while others are still soft.
mistakes.fix: Cut thin rounds of one thickness.

quiz.question: Why fry a cured sausage only briefly?
choices: It is already cured, and long frying makes it hard and bitter.
quiz.because: The sausage only needs its fat to run and its edges to crisp.

quiz.question: How much fat goes in the pan?
choices: Very little or none, since the sausage gives its own.
quiz.because: The sausage gives off plenty of fat of its own.

quiz.question: Which sign says the rounds are done?
choices: They are black at the edges.
The fat runs red and the edges curl.
quiz.because: Running fat and curled edges show they are ready.

quiz.question: The rounds turned hard and bitter. What should change?
choices: Lower the heat and take them off sooner.
quiz.because: A medium heat for a short time keeps them tender.

variant_of.differs: A cured, ready-spiced sausage in thin rounds gives up its fat within moments over medium heat, so it is fried briefly, not melted slowly like a fatty cut.
